title: Just Protect The Signal
style: electronic anthem, 114 BPM, resolving confident male vocal, builds from data paranoia to human power, clean production, signal vs noise theme, ZYNTHIO philosophy, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Everything is noise until it isn't
Every feed is fog until it clears
The signal always was there waiting
Underneath the manufactured fears

[CHORUS]
Just protect the signal
Not the noise — the signal
Just protect the signal
Human — you define it
Just protect the signal
Filter — then align it
Just protect the signal
That's the ZYNTHIO design

[VERSE 2]
Thirty-six incidents logged this week
Seven were real — the rest was bleed
Signal from the noise — that's the job
Human in the loop — don't let them rob
The context you built — protect it
The work you did — reflect it
The signal that you are — project it
Human in the loop — correct it

[OUTRO]
Signal. Not noise. Protect it. Always.
